youtube.title: Paul Revere never yelled 'The British are coming!' 🐎 #shorts
youtube.caption:
The midnight ride of Paul Revere… and the guy history forgot. 🐎

William Dawes rode the SAME night. Nobody wrote him a poem.

Team Revere or Team Dawes? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: on April 18, 1775 Paul Revere and William Dawes both rode to warn Lexington. Revere was caught by a British patrol, Dawes was thrown from his horse. Revere warned that "the Regulars are coming out" (colonists were British too). Longfellow's 1860 poem made only Revere famous.
